items.title: Goal
items.text:
Prepare a small-risk pytest-focused stable release by promoting selected existing development-channel features to stable.yaml and hardening the pytest features that already ship in stable.

The release should expand pytest coverage without shipping the Pytest Explorer tool window, fixture refactoring workflows, or Explorer-backed collection/search surfaces.

items.title: Promotion Candidates
items.text:
Promote these existing dev-channel features to the stable release channel:

  • _pytest-fixture-engine
  • convert-pytest-param
  • copy-pytest-node-id-from-editor
  • copy-pytest-node-ids
  • jump-to-pytest-node-in-test-tree
  • new-pytest-members
  • parametrize-pytest-test
  • pytest-fixture-direct-import-inspection
  • pytest-fixture-scope-inspection
  • pytest-fixture-uninjected-reference-inspection
  • pytest-fixture-unused-inspection
  • pytest-hooks
  • pytest-identifier-search-everywhere
  • pytest-plugins-in-non-root-conftest-inspection
  • pytest-redundant-fixture-import-inspection
  • pytest-usefixtures-on-fixture-noop-inspection
  • run-with-debug-logging
  • surround-with-pytest-raises
  • toggle-pytest-skip
  • toggle-pytest-skip-from-test-tree

The _pytest-fixture-engine feature is included as supporting infrastructure for fixture-aware inspections, fixture documentation, and fixture-related editor behavior. It is not a user-facing UI feature.

items.title: Explicit Exclusions
items.text:
Do not promote these features in this release:

  • pytest-explorer
  • pytest-explorer-gutter-icons
  • pytest-search-everywhere
  • extract-pytest-fixture
  • inline-pytest-fixture
  • pull-up-pytest-fixture
  • push-down-pytest-fixture
  • pytest-fixture-editor-integration
  • structure-view-pytest-kind-icons

Also hold back newer pytest inspections that still use since: 'NEXT' until they receive separate release metadata and validation.

items.title: Existing Stable Hardening
items.text:
Include a bug-fix pass for pytest features already present in stable.yaml:

  • pytest-failed-line-inspection
  • pytest-fixture-documentation
  • pytest-parametrized-case-run-gutter-icon

The hardening pass should prioritize regressions, feature-gate behavior, threading/read-action safety, false positives, and compatibility with the stable release-channel resource filtering.

items.title: Implementation Shape
items.text:
Update src/main/resources/feature-sets/stable.yaml by adding the promotion candidates in alphabetical order, preserving the explicit allowlist model.

For promoted features with docs pages, ensure their documentation remains reachable in the stable documentation build. For generated README output, use the existing README feature-list workflow rather than hand-editing generated blocks.

Do not add new feature IDs, new settings flags, or new user-facing behavior beyond stable-channel inclusion and bug fixes discovered during hardening.

items.title: Validation
items.text:
Run focused tests for the promoted features and existing stable pytest features, including:

  • feature metadata and generated plugin XML validation
  • settings snapshot regeneration if stable-channel promotion changes rendered settings coverage
  • README feature-list check or regeneration
  • stable documentation build
  • targeted test classes for promoted pytest actions, intentions, inspections, completion/navigation integrations, and test-tree actions
  • targeted regression tests for the three already-stable pytest features

Use JBR/JDK 21 for Gradle runs, matching the repository guidance.

items.title: Risk Notes
items.text:
Promoted test-tree actions may integrate with both IntelliJ's test tree popup and BetterPy's Explorer popup group. The release intentionally excludes the Explorer tool window, but keeps these actions because their normal IntelliJ test tree paths are independent of the Explorer UI.

pytest-search-everywhere remains excluded because it depends on the Pytest Explorer collection service even when the Explorer tool window is not shipped.

Fixture refactoring support remains excluded because rename/find-usages/override line markers have a wider blast radius than inspections and small editor actions.

structure-view-pytest-kind-icons remains excluded because it is not a standalone pytest feature: it is wired through the broader enhanced-python-structure-view wrapper, which is outside this pytest-focused release scope.
